title: DonkeyCar Fork
description: Added and improved self-driving functionalities in the DonkeyCar framework, including line- and lane-following behaviors and obstacle avoidance, enabling our RC car to navigate a track completely autonomously with a team at UCSD.

title: Tag Analysis on Recipe Data
description: Performed statistical analysis on a toy dataset of internet recipes as an exercise in data modeling for DSC80 at UCSD.

title: Emissions Data Visualization Project
description: Created visualizations for World Bank data on urbanization and emissions, and explored various data processing and visualization techniques in order to sway viewers towards one or another viewpoint.
